boundary_evidence: HISTORY: UPPER SIDE OF A HOLE-SPLIT RUN. tools/tu_map.py calls 0x020e3854..0x020e6bf4 one contiguous linker run of 52 function(s) (build/tu_map.json), labeled dScMgCurling2_c. The sourceless hole at func_ov006_020e5450 (ROM ordinal 31, size 0x560, a banked near-miss draft) splits it: no delink block and no TU manifest in this tree expresses a .text claim with a hole in it, so the run licenses as its two contiguous sides. The lower side is ov006/dScMgCurling2_c (0x020e3854..0x020e5450, 31 functions); this TU is the upper side, 0x020e59b0..0x020e6bf4, 20 functions, ROM ordinals 32..51. The zero-gap factory dScMgCurling2_c_classInit at 0x020e6bf4 is the next linker unit (src/d_s_mg_curling2.cpp), not a member of this TU.

WHY A SECOND MANIFEST FOR THE SAME CLASS. dScMgCurling2_c's key function -- the destructor declared out of line and FIRST in include/dScMgCurling2_c.h -- lives in the lower TU, which licenses the class's _ZTV/_ZTI/_ZTS and its deadstripped D2. This side holds four of the six own vtable overrides (InitResources, Behavior, Render, OnYoshiTryEat) and defines no key function, so it emits none of the class's vague-linkage output: compiler_only_output is empty -- the dScMgCoin_c sibling outcome the lower manifest's boundary analysis predicted.

MEMBERSHIP IS ROM-PROVEN, NOT INFERRED. Eight of the twenty functions are the destination of an 8-byte {code pointer, zero adjustment} pointer-to-member record in unowned ov006 .data (0x0213c3d4..0x0213c47c), which __sinit_ov006_02130758 copies into the BSS dispatch arrays: the five Behavior-state handlers ride data_ov006_02141a18 on mState, and the four stone-state handlers ride data_ov006_021419d8 on mStone[i].state, dispatched through the same pointer-to-member table shape as the lower TU. The remaining twelve take the object as their first argument and index its layout; the four already-mangled vtable overrides carry their own slot evidence.
module sinit corroboration: same sinit/d_ctor frame as ov006/dScMgCurling2_c -- one contiguous run, two licensed sides

HOLE FILLED, FACTORY NOT FOLDED (2026-10-10): func_ov006_020e5450 now byte-matches and is the last function of the lower TU (ov006/dScMgCurling2_c, .text 0x020e3854..0x020e59b0), so this side abuts it with no gap. dScMgCurling2_c_classInit (0x020e6bf4, size 0x34) still stays in src/d_s_mg_curling2.cpp: appended here as `return new dScMgCurling2_c;` it verifies 21/21 in ROM order, but `tubuild linkcheck --baseline --module ov006` refuses this text-only object (tools/objisolate.py plan_many: _ZTV15dScMgCurling2_c is undefined here, because the key function is in the lower TU, and the vptr store carries addend 8, which text-only production isolation cannot rewrite). Merging the two halves into one TU, which then owns the vtable, is what unblocks the fold.
notes: Hand-assembled, per notes/agents/roles/writer.md: this TU is the upper side of a hole-split run, which tubuild create's whole-unit flow does not express. Each member's own recovered declarations were merged by hand into one file-scope extern "C" region; decl_common.h is deliberately NOT included, same as the lower TU -- its spellings contradict the byte-matched shards.

METHOD-CONVERSION PASS. All 20 members are real dScMgCurling2_c:: methods declared in include/dScMgCurling2_c.h; every conversion is byte-neutral under tools/match.py --module ov006 (20/20 MATCH). The 12 callers the lower manifest's notes marked as the migration dependency are all in this TU now and call member names: StoneWait calls SeparateStones, NextThrow calls AgeMarks and NextStone, Play dispatches its two PMF tables, BeginRound/OnYoshiTryEat call ResetGame/Scroll/NextStone, InitResources calls SeedPieces and the game-reset chain.

SYMBOLS.TXT IS PART OF THIS EDIT. Sixteen of the renamed members are the destination of an 8-byte {code pointer, zero adjustment} pointer-to-member record in unowned ov006 .data, which __sinit_ov006_02130758 copies into the BSS dispatch arrays. dsd resolves those records BY SYMBOL NAME, so all twenty rows in config/arm9/overlays/ov006/symbols.txt moved to the mangled spelling in the same commit; a row left behind would link its .data code word as 0x00000000 with a green compile.

RAWHOLDERS. Six members keep the shards' raw `this + 0x46xx/0x55xx` addressing because folding through the named members loses the base rematerialization: StoneSpin, StoneSlide, NextStone, SeedStones (its `struct E` + 0x4000 split base), Play and ResetGame -- the same measured reason as SpawnValue and the two mark functions in the lower TU. func_ov006_020e5450 stays extern "C": the hole's own cartridge bytes cover it and the banked draft is nonmatching.

THE TWENTY-EIGHT NAMES ARE COINED. The ROM proves member-ness (a zero-adjustment pointer-to-member record, and each handler's index in its own table read out of __sinit_ov006_02130758). It does not carry the original identifiers; the names read the field semantics recorded in include/dScMgCurling2_c.h, and the ones whose semantics stayed unproven kept honest unk_ spellings.
